workflowHelp: Choose a service and track each step without losing the sale.
demoWarning: DEMO: fictional data, non-payable QR. No real charge, tax document or refund.
connectToContinue: Connect an authorized service in settings to perform this operation.
paymentHelp: Each charge keeps one reference. Check its result before trying again.
expiryCheck: Code expired. Check the result before creating another charge.
paymentUncertain: Wait for confirmation. Do not charge again or release goods with an uncertain payment.
paymentApproved: Charge approved. Completing the sale requires joint stock, payment and tax-document confirmation.
paymentDeclined: Charge declined. Check the reason with the provider before choosing another method.
creditHelp: Select the customer, check the limit and review installments before requesting approval.
fiscalHelp: Select a recorded sale. The tax service validates company settings and rules.
fiscalRejected: Document rejected. Review the tax response before resubmitting.
fiscalContingency: Contingency requested. Authorization and deadlines depend on the configured tax service.
fiscalIssued: Document issued by the tax service.
documentPending: The connected tax service provides the document copy.
loyaltyHelp: Look up membership and balance with customer consent. The service controls point rules.
pointsNoDiscount: Redemption does not change the total until the sale receives service confirmation.
consentRequired: Enter a name and consent to register.
discountHelp95: Review the original price and proposed total. Approval requires permission and supervisor confirmation.
supervisorHelp: The password is sent only to the authorized service and is not saved here.
refundHelp95: Select the sale and the amount to refund. Authorization does not erase the original sale.
originalSalePreserved: The original sale is preserved. The return remains linked to its refund reference.
devicesHelp: Choose a device and test communication before using it at checkout.
driverRequired: Printer, drawer and terminal require an installed, authorized application connector.
pairingHelp: Pair a phone with this register to check receipts using the authorized app.
pairSteps: In the phone app, choose Check register and enter this code. Reconnect to resume the same review.
pairExpired: Code expired. Check the pairing before generating another.
noPhotoSaved: Review stores checked fields; this screen does not store receipt images.
sameOperation: Query this same operation. Do not create another to replace a missing response.
resolveFirst: Resolve the pending operation before starting another.
invalidReply: Response could not be validated. Query the same operation.
requestUncertain: Response uncertain. Check the result; do not repeat the charge.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code manually.
needCash: Open or select a register first.
permission: You do not have permission for this action.
nonFiscal: NON-TAX RECEIPT. Does not replace a tax document.
printReceipt: Print or save receipt as PDF
popupBlocked: Allow the print window in your browser and try again.
reportHelp: Missing values appear as —. Local requests do not change the official balance. Archives are stored on this computer per user and company.
printReport: Print or save report as PDF
localModeNotice: This installation has no connector for this service yet. Setup remains available; no operation is confirmed without the provider.
consent: The customer authorized loyalty lookup and registration.
invalid: Check the entered fields and amounts.
phoneHelp: Enter the register code. Review the data before sending each receipt.
cameraHelp95: Read the image and fill in the fields. Automatic reading depends on the device reader; manual fields remain available.
cameraUnavailable: Camera unavailable. Check permissions or use manual fields.
paymentGate95: A charge or discount needs resolution in Payments and documents. Check or cancel it before finalizing in cash.
recovering95: Previous operation selected. Check its result; the current cart will not change.
